conventions.name: package-directories-have-required-files
conventions.description: Publishable package directories must keep the source directory, manifest, and changelog together.

conventions.name: source-modules-are-not-barrels
conventions.description: Source modules must not be pure re-export barrels; package exports point at real modules instead.

conventions.name: non-signer-sources-must-not-import-remote-signers
conventions.description: Core, shared, format, and validator sources cannot import remote signer packages.

conventions.name: non-react-sources-must-not-import-a1
conventions.description: A1 is a signer package; only the React browser hooks package may import it.

conventions.name: core-shared-sources-must-not-import-formats
conventions.description: Core and shared sources cannot import format packages.

conventions.name: non-validator-sources-must-not-import-validator
conventions.description: Validators are leaf product surfaces and cannot be imported by non-validator sources.

conventions.name: signer-sources-must-not-import-a1
conventions.description: Signer packages are self-contained and cannot import another signer package.

conventions.name: signer-sources-must-not-import-assinafy
conventions.description: Signer packages are self-contained and cannot import another signer package.

conventions.name: signer-sources-must-not-import-clicksign
conventions.description: Signer packages are self-contained and cannot import another signer package.

conventions.name: signer-sources-must-not-import-documenso
conventions.description: Signer packages are self-contained and cannot import another signer package.

conventions.name: signer-sources-must-not-import-docuseal
conventions.description: Signer packages are self-contained and cannot import another signer package.

conventions.name: signer-sources-must-not-import-zapsign
conventions.description: Signer packages are self-contained and cannot import another signer package.

conventions.name: remote-signer-index-surface
conventions.description: Remote signer entry modules expose the uniform provider surface.
